prose:
A Reuters excerpt indexed by Techmeme reports planned screenshot restrictions in Signal to reduce AI-agent access to private conversations. The excerpt explicitly says the protections are incomplete; the full article was inaccessible.

A screenshot control should not be treated as a guarantee that no agent can access message content through any route. Platform coverage, exceptions and rollout details were not checked, and no user privacy settings were changed.
highlights: Evidence is an indexed report excerpt
Protection is explicitly described as incomplete
Screenshot capture is only one access route
